Being able to see the castle lit up on the far hillside from right inside the village is what sells the scale here - a lot of these fantasy scenes cut between a close village shot and a separate wide castle shot with no real sense they're the same place. Here it reads as one continuous valley you could actually walk across. Everyone in this village must be asleep by now, not a single window looks like it still has someone up working in it.

I'm not gonna pretend I had it all figured out, because I didn't. Manifesting felt like failing for years. I'd try, get nowhere, tell myself I'd get it next time, and then nothing again. It got to the point where I figured maybe some people just aren't wired for it and I was one of them. Then I took Amara Lorne arche type quiz, kind of as a last thing to try. And it hit something. My arche type just fit, in a way that made me go oh. No fireworks, no life suddenly fixed. But for the first time I had direction instead of just fumbling in the dark hoping something would stick. If you're struggling with it too, honestly, do the quiz. Its free anyway.
